name: Wonderland Concept Proposal
tagline: A complete 26-slide dark concept proposal with Lunchtype 22 headlines, Junicode italics, tiny Optician Sans navigation, cinematic imagery and native design-planning diagrams.

palette.description: Near-black canvas with warm white typography, mustard and charcoal concept color swatches, and iridescent 3D artwork.

typography.style: Source fonts embedded unchanged: Lunchtype 22 Light 300, Regular 400 and Medium 500; Junicode Italic 400 for section labels; Optician Sans for 16px navigation/captions. Original 1920 × 1080 text frames, weights, line heights and letter spacing are preserved.

best_for: Complete design proposals connecting the client brief and research to competitor analysis, information architecture, creative concept, color, typography, photography, next steps and delivery timeline.
avoid_for: Dense financial dashboards, casual classroom handouts, or decks without high-quality independent photography/product imagery. Keep tiny chrome and the fixed composition within each layout’s source capacity.

source_inspiration.notes: All 26 source pages rebuilt as static native HTML/CSS/SVG using public slide objects and measured source DOM. Source artwork and photographs are independent embedded image slots, losslessly re-encoded to WebP. The three source website mockups on slides 20–21 remain independent replaceable interface screenshot slots; the surrounding slide text, frames and native diagrams remain editable. This is a visual reconstruction, not the original editable Pitch file. Font license notices are embedded in HTML source.
